prose: Short note from feed metadata only: Reuters reports that insurance software maker Guidewire has agreed to acquire hyperexponential - the London startup behind AI-powered underwriting and pricing software for insurers - for $1.7 billion in cash, plus up to $400 million more (per the feed excerpt, likely earnout terms). One of the year's larger vertical-AI exits. The source is error-cached, so deal terms beyond the headline figures are unverified.
